relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: Pain behavior and immunohistochemistry results showed that intrathecal infusion of PDTC at 100 or 1000 pmol/d prevented the development of mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia, spinal microglial activation and TNF-a expression induced by sciatic nerve CCI in rats.

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavior results showed that intrathecal administration of PDTC in the early phase (on 1 day before to 2 day after surgery) alleviated the CCI-induced thermal hyperalgesia on day 1-3 after surgery and inhibited the mechanical hyperalgesia on day 2-3 after surgery (Figure1A).

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemistry analysis showed that PDTC had inhibitory effect on spinal spinal microgliosis both early and late phases of CCI (Figure 2).

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: PDTC decreased the expression of OX-42 and the number of ipsilateral spinal OX-42 immunoreactive (IR) cells in a dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: PDTC decreased the expression of TNF-a in a dose-dependent manner, compared to that of CCI group (p<0.05).

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: TNF-a-dependent phosphorylation of NF-κB p65 was inhibited when cells were pretreated with PDTC (100umol/l), while PDTC cannot alter the constitutive p-p65 expression in microglial cells.

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: In BV-2 microglial cells, we found that TNF-α induced an increase in CX3CR1 mRNA and protein expression and the nuclear translocation of NF-κB p-p65 in BV-2 microglial cells may be the critical step for upregulating CX3CR1 expression.

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: After TNF-a induction, nuclear p-p65 expression increased and reached the peak in 1 h (Figure 4).

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that PDTC inhibited the expression of constitutive and TNF-α-induced CX3CR1 mRNA and protein.

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: As shown in Figure 3, TNF-a expression increased significantly in the ipsilateral spinal cord in CCI rats (p<0.05).

relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: As shown in Figure 2, OX-42-expressed cells increased significantly in the ipsilateral spinal cord in CCI rats.

relationships.subject: NF-kappaB
relationships.evidence_quote: In this study, we observed the dose-dependent suppressive effect of intrathecal PDTC on mTNF-α expression induced by CCI, therefore, our data demonstrated that NF-κB activation could mediate spinal mTNF-α production.

relationships.subject: CX3CR1
relationships.evidence_quote: Blocking CX3CR1 could attenuate and delay the development of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: minocycline
relationships.evidence_quote: Studies also proved that chronic intrathecal infusion of microglia inhibitor, minocycline, could prevent the development of SNL-induced pain in rats and reduce the proinflammatory cytokine expression in rat models.

key_findings: Intrathecal PDTC dose-dependently prevented and reversed CCI-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia while reducing spinal OX-42 microglial activation and TNF-alpha expression in rats.
In BV-2 microglia, TNF-alpha upregulated CX3CR1 mRNA and protein via NF-kappaB p65 phosphorylation, and PDTC blocked both the p65 phosphorylation and the CX3CR1 upregulation.
